gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Total Governmental Funds 'Transfer from other funds' 98,800 is a net figure: General Fund 147,800 + Street Fund 70,000 + Lottery Fund (119,000) = 98,800 (the 98,800 comes from the Sanitation Fund, p7). Detail records the transfers gross per fund/department: General Fund departments pp13-14 Administration 110,500 + Pool 20,000 + Park 10,300 + Auditorium 7,000 + Fire 20,250 = 168,050 in (and Fire Equipment -20,250 out; net 147,800 = GF column p5) + Street 70,000 (p10) = 238,050 in. 238,050 - 98,800 = 139,250 = Lottery transfer out 119,000 (netted in the Total column) + intra-General-Fund Fire Equipment -> Fire 20,250 (nets to zero in the GF column). Gross vs net only; no fix.

Statement transfers_out 50,395 = p5 'Transfer to Genoa Medical Facility' (50,395) only (Total column; the other transfers are netted into 'Transfer from other funds'). Detail transfers out: GF Administration 'Transfer to Genoa Medical Facility' -50,395 (p13) + GF Fire Equipment -20,250 (p14) + Lottery Fund -119,000 (p11) = 189,645. 189,645 - 50,395 = 139,250 = Lottery 119,000 + intra-GF 20,250, the same amounts netted on the transfers_in side. Gross vs net only; no fix.

p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Water Fund, Sewer Fund and Sanitation Fund columns; none of their lines are in detail[]. JSON statement receipts 378,306 = total operating revenues 377,490 + Interest income 816. Water: Sales 161,473 + Late payment fees 4,710 + Tap fees 100 + Other revenue 115 = 166,398 (printed) + Interest income 111 = 166,509. Sewer: Sales 89,001 + Other revenue 111 = 89,112 (printed) + Interest income 705 = 89,817. Sanitation: Sales 121,980 (printed). 166,509 + 89,817 + 121,980 = 378,306. Check: 0 + 378,306 = 378,306 = statement total.
